answer.rationale: Use the low-cost quote as a benchmark to seek an incumbent renewal that achieves the 18% spend target while preserving proven delivery and integration stability. This is preferable to a primary-source migration 14 days before expiry while the line has only 6% volume headroom. Verify memory_c4 because its original record is directly relevant to whether renewal benchmarking can credibly move incumbent price and payment terms enough to satisfy the mandate. If the incumbent cannot meet the required economics promptly, the low-cost quote remains a contingency, but its delivery performance under current capacity conditions is not established by the inherited record.
